title: P-z combinations that you should memorize

cues.en: Mike: Every distribution has an associated set of P-values, because every distribution can be converted into a probability distribution.
cues.zh: Mike：每個分布都有一組對應的 P 值，因為每個分布都能轉換成機率分布。

cues.en: Now, some distributions are more important than others because they're used more often than others, and the most important distribution
cues.zh: 有些分布比其他更重要，因為更常使用，而整個統計，

cues.en: in like all of statistics, maybe even all of the entire universe, is the normal distribution, AKA, the bell curve, AKA, the Gaussian distribution,
cues.zh: 甚至整個宇宙最重要的分布，就是常態分布，也叫鐘形曲線、高斯分布，

cues.en: AKA, the standard distribution.
cues.zh: 也叫標準分布。

cues.en: It has so many names because it's so important, and there are specific combinations of P-values and Z-values that I think are so frequent,
cues.zh: 名稱很多，是因為很重要。有些特定 P 值和 Z 值組合出現得非常頻繁，

cues.en: they come up so often that I think it's worth committing to memory, not only for if you're doing this for a course, in an exam, you might be asked to report these numbers,
cues.zh: 我認為值得記住，不只是因為修課、考試可能要求寫出這些數字，

cues.en: but if you are moving into a career that will involve a lot of data analysis, statistics, machine learning,
cues.zh: 如果未來職涯會涉及很多資料分析、統計、機器學習，

cues.en: then I think it's really useful to commit these values that I'm going to tell you in this lecture to memory.
cues.zh: 記住這堂課要介紹的數值，會非常有用。

cues.en: Trust me, you'll be thankful.
cues.zh: 相信我，你會慶幸記住了。

cues.en: I memorized these things, like, God, it was probably about 20 years ago, I guess, when I took my Stats 101 course in university, and I memorized them
cues.zh: 大概 20 年前，大學上統計入門課時，我把它們背起來，

cues.en: and I still use these numbers pretty often.
cues.zh: 現在仍然經常用到。

cues.en: Okay, so first we're gonna start off actually not with P-values.
cues.zh: 首先，其實不是從 P 值開始。

cues.en: We're gonna start off just with Z-values and proportion of data.
cues.zh: 而是從 Z 值，以及資料比例開始。

cues.en: So here we have our bell curve.
cues.zh: 這裡是鐘形曲線。

cues.en: This is our normal standard Gaussian distribution.
cues.zh: 也就是標準常態高斯分布。

cues.en: And remember that one of the great things about the standard distribution is that the units here are in standard deviations.
cues.zh: 記住，標準分布的一個優點，是這裡以標準差為單位。

cues.en: So when you have a population or a sample that is distributed according to a Gaussian, then we can say that 68.3% of the data are contained
cues.zh: 母體或樣本呈高斯分布時，可以說 68.3% 的資料包含在

cues.en: within two standard deviations around the mean.
cues.zh: 平均值周圍，總寬度兩個標準差之內。

cues.en: And by two, just to be clear, I mean minus one standard deviation to plus one standard deviation.
cues.zh: 說清楚，這裡的兩個是指，從負一個標準差到正一個標準差。

cues.en: So we can take the practical example of IQ, IQ tests.
cues.zh: 實際例子可以用 IQ，也就是智商測驗。

cues.en: The average IQ test score is 100, and the standard deviation is 15.
cues.zh: IQ 平均分數為 100，標準差為 15。

cues.en: So that means if we take the average IQ score minus one standard deviation to plus one standard deviation,
cues.zh: 所以平均分數減去一個標準差，到加上一個標準差，

cues.en: so that gets us from an IQ test score of 85 to 115, we can say that 68.3% of all people who take the IQ exam
cues.zh: 也就是 IQ 分數 85 到 115，包含所有參加測驗者的 68.3%，

cues.en: are in between one standard deviation of the mean on both sides.
cues.zh: 落在平均值兩側各一個標準差之內。

cues.en: So in this boundary of two standard deviations.
cues.zh: 也就是總寬度兩個標準差的邊界。

cues.en: Okay, and then we go out further and we get to four standard deviations around the mean, which means minus two standard deviations and plus two standard deviations,
cues.zh: 再往外，平均值周圍總寬度四個標準差，也就是負二到正二個標準差，

cues.en: and that is 95.5% of the data.
cues.zh: 包含 95.5% 的資料。

cues.en: So for any given distribution that is Gaussian distributed, 95.5% of the data points in that distribution
cues.zh: 所以對任何高斯分布，95.5% 的資料點，

cues.en: are between minus two and plus two standard deviations around the mean, okay?
cues.zh: 都在平均值周圍負二到正二個標準差之間，好嗎？

cues.en: And then the outer boundary here is three standard deviations, and that includes 99.7% of the data.
cues.zh: 最外側邊界則是三個標準差，包含 99.7% 的資料。

cues.en: So you can see it's very, very rare to be more than three standard deviations away from the mean of a Gaussian distribution.
cues.zh: 所以，距離高斯分布平均值超過三個標準差，非常少見。

cues.en: So these numbers you should commit to memory, in my opinion.
cues.zh: 我認為應該記住這些數字。

cues.en: I recommend it.
cues.zh: 建議記下來。

cues.en: Okay, so this is just about Z-values and proportion of the dataset.
cues.zh: 這是 Z 值和資料集比例。

cues.en: So here we get to P-Z pairs.
cues.zh: 接著是 P、Z 配對。

cues.en: This is actually the title of this lecture.
cues.zh: 這其實就是這堂課的標題。

cues.en: So for a one-tailed test, I'm gonna show you the two-tailed test on the next slide.
cues.zh: 先看單尾檢定，下一張會展示雙尾。

cues.en: For a one-tailed test, a Z-value of 1.64 corresponds to a P-value of 0.05.
cues.zh: 單尾檢定中，Z=1.64 對應 P=0.05。

cues.en: So what does that mean?
cues.zh: 什麼意思？

cues.en: That means if we take 0.05 as our statistical significance threshold, then finding a P-value of 0.05
cues.zh: 如果把 0.05 當作統計顯著性門檻，找到 P=0.05，

cues.en: means that our observed data are 1.64 standard deviations away from the mean of the null hypothesis distribution.
cues.zh: 就表示觀察資料距離虛無假設分布的平均值 1.64 個標準差。

cues.en: That's what this means.
cues.zh: 就是這個意思。

cues.en: Conversely, if we go for a P-value threshold of 0.01, then we say that our observed test statistic
cues.zh: 反過來，如果 P 值門檻為 0.01，觀察到的檢定統計量，

cues.en: must be more than 2.32 standard deviations away from the mean of the null hypothesis distribution in order for us to consider that effect
cues.zh: 必須距離虛無假設分布平均值超過 2.32 個標準差，才能把效果

cues.en: to be statistically significant at a P-value threshold of 0.01, okay?
cues.zh: 視為在 P 值門檻 0.01 下具有統計顯著性，好嗎？

cues.en: And then 0.01 is a Z-value of 3.09.
So these are the one tailed Z-values.
cues.zh: 這些是單尾 Z 值。

cues.en: Here we get the two tailed Z-values, and remember from the previous lecture, the end of the previous lecture, in general, you always want to do two-tailed tests
cues.zh: 這裡是雙尾 Z 值，記得前一堂結尾說過，一般總是應該做雙尾檢定，

cues.en: unless you have a really, really good, compelling reason to do a one-tailed test.
cues.zh: 除非有非常充分、有說服力的理由，才做單尾。

cues.en: Okay, so P equals 0.05 corresponds to a Z-value of 1.96.
Now, these Z values are actually larger than the previous slide, because these are two-tailed.
cues.zh: 這些 Z 值比前一張投影片大，因為是雙尾。

cues.en: So this means, actually, I guess I probably should have written this, plus minus 1.96, because this corresponds to plus 1.96 on the right,
cues.zh: 所以這裡其實應該寫正負 1.96，右側對應 +1.96，

cues.en: minus 1.96 over here.
cues.zh: 這裡則是 −1.96。

cues.en: P-value of 0.01 corresponds to a Z-value of 2.58 and a P-value of 0.01 corresponds to a Z-value of 3.29,
so almost 3.3.
cues.zh: 也就是接近 3.3。

cues.en: And again, to repeat the interpretation, what this means is that if you say that I'm going to use a P-value threshold of 0.001
cues.zh: 再重複解讀方式，如果使用 P 值門檻 0.001

cues.en: as a significance threshold, then the effect that you observe in your sample data, in your experimental data,
cues.zh: 作為顯著性門檻，那麼樣本、實驗資料中觀察到的效果，

cues.en: that effect must be more than 3.29 standard deviations away from the mean of the null hypothesis distribution
cues.zh: 必須距離虛無假設分布平均值超過 3.29 個標準差，

cues.en: in order to consider that effect to be statistically significant.
cues.zh: 才能視為具有統計顯著性。

cues.en: And again, this is plus or minus, so it's either 3.3 standard deviations over here, or 3.3 standard deviations off to the left, depending on the direction of the effect.
cues.zh: 再次提醒，是正負，也就是這側 3.3 個標準差，或左側 3.3 個標準差，取決於效果方向。

cues.en: So there you go, some Z-value and proportion data that are worth committing to memory and some P-value and Z-value pairs that are also worth committing to memory.
cues.zh: 這就是值得記住的一些 Z 值與資料比例，以及同樣值得記住的 P 值和 Z 值配對。
